tools.name: touring_activity_replay
tools.description: Replay all events in the activity log and produce the deterministic projection. Returns total event count and projection hash.

tools.name: touring_activity_verify
tools.description: Verify the integrity of the activity log by recomputing the projection hash and comparing against the stored hash. Returns failure count and failed seq numbers.

tools.name: touring_session
tools.description: Session lifecycle: start, checkpoint, assess, end, list, get

tools.name: touring_refactor
tools.description: Safe refactoring: analyze symbol impact, rename with AST, validate syntax, preview changes

tools.name: touring_evolution_status
tools.description: Get status of the self-evolution engine: learning state, drift detection, watcher stats

tools.name: touring_evolution_drift
tools.description: Query drift detection results from Touring's learning engine. Optionally filter by metric name. Returns drift status for all tracked metrics: drift_detected, magnitude, direction, confidence, and trend label. Use to identify which metrics in the system are degrading or improving over time.

tools.name: touring_ctx_gain
tools.description:
Token-savings dashboard. Aggregates per-session GateMetrics \
                       counters into bytes_saved + tokens_saved + human-readable \
                       summary. Read-only, <5ms. Use to surface 'value Touring delivered \
                       this session'.

tools.name: touring_ctx_replay
tools.description: T1-01: Replay last N session steps as compressed summaries. Useful after /clear to reload the LLM mental model without rehydrating raw outputs.

tools.name: touring_ctx_gain_graph
tools.description: T1-05: ASCII sparkline of bytes_saved over last N days using ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█. Renderable in any terminal, zero deps.

tools.name: touring_ctx_session_adoption
tools.description: T1-06: Adoption ratio for the current session — routed_bash + compressed / total_bash. Surfaces 'how much value Touring is delivering this session'.

tools.name: touring_ctx_explain
tools.description: T1-10: Explain a GateMetrics counter — returns its current value, plain-English description, and related counters. Use to interpret gate-metrics output.

tools.name: touring_ctx_batch_execute
tools.description: T1-12: Bundle multiple ctx_* invocations into a single MCP call. Pass `items` as JSON array of {kind, ...args}. kinds: replay, smart, doctor, gain_history. Reduces roundtrip latency.

tools.name: touring_ctx_upgrade
tools.description: T1-14: Plan / report a Touring rebuild + symlink + restart. Pass `dry_run: true` for a plan only; live invocation requires CLI for safety.

tools.name: touring_ctx_discover_session
tools.description: T1-15: Scan hook_events for the current session, identify Bash invocations whose result was >5KB AND classify_tool_routing was Passthrough. Surface missed savings ranked by est_bytes.

tools.name: touring_ctx_linucb_compression
tools.description: T2-01: LinUCB-driven compression decisions envelope.

tools.name: touring_ctx_burn_detect
tools.description: T2-02: Detect tool-call-burn patterns in current session.

tools.name: touring_ctx_precompact_recompress
tools.description: T2-03: PreCompact aggressive recompression envelope.

tools.name: touring_ctx_session_inheritance
tools.description: T2-04: Cross-session inheritance — replay top lessons.

tools.name: touring_ctx_search_regex
tools.description: T2-05: Tantivy RegexQuery wrapper.

tools.name: touring_ctx_search_phrase_prefix

tools.name: touring_ctx_aggregate_daily

tools.name: touring_ctx_top_compressors

tools.name: touring_ctx_think_in_code

tools.name: touring_ctx_roi
tools.description: T2-10: USD savings via pricing model.

tools.name: touring_ctx_read_summary

tools.name: touring_ctx_webfetch_chunk

tools.name: touring_ctx_grep_rerank
tools.description: T2-13: BM25 rerank Grep hits.

tools.name: touring_ctx_err_filter
tools.description: T2-14: Generic error-only filter.

tools.name: touring_ctx_tier_lift
tools.description: T2-15: session_tier_lift Think-in-Code at Tier3.

tools.name: touring_ctx_web_status

tools.name: touring_ctx_otlp_status
tools.description: T3-07: OpenTelemetry exporter status.

tools.name: touring_ctx_graphql_status

tools.name: touring_ctx_polyglot_summary
tools.description: T3-09: Cross-language polyglot summary.

tools.name: touring_ctx_pr_risk_score
tools.description: T3-10: CI/CD risk gates — PR risk score.

tools.name: touring_ast_overview
tools.description: Extract symbols from source code with TOON format output

tools.name: touring_ast_find
tools.description: Find symbols by name across project files

tools.name: touring_classify_intent
tools.description: CILA L0-L6 intent classification using 48-pattern RegexSet

tools.name: touring_memory_store
tools.description: Store a memory entry in RLM + SemanticRecall

tools.name: touring_memory_clusters
tools.description: Pattern clustering via HNSW-based lazy clustering

tools.name: touring_cluster_skills
tools.description: Skill clustering: record usage, compute clusters, find similar

tools.name: touring_ast_edit
tools.description: AST surgery: replace symbol body or validate syntax

tools.name: touring_index_status
tools.description: Get project index status and configuration

tools.name: touring_checkpoint
tools.description: Create a checkpoint file

tools.name: touring_file_ops
tools.description: File operations: read, write, append, delete, find/search, stat, exists, mkdir, copy, move/rename, glob, tree

tools.name: touring_project
tools.description: Get project configuration and status

tools.name: touring_resolve_project
tools.description: Resolves a file path to its corresponding project root using longest-prefix match across indexed projects. Returns the project directory that owns the file.

tools.name: touring_find_references
tools.description: Finds all references to the symbol at a given position. Supports workspace and project scope.

tools.name: touring_rename
tools.description: Renames a symbol across all references. Use apply=true to commit changes, or false for a dry run preview.

tools.name: touring_entity_define
tools.description: Define a new entity in the identity registry

tools.name: touring_entity_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an entity name with exact or fuzzy matching

tools.name: touring_entity_relate
tools.description: Create a relation between two entities

tools.name: touring_entity_list
tools.description: List entities with optional crate and kind filters

tools.name: touring_entity_delete
tools.description: Delete an entity from the registry

tools.name: touring_generator_validate_plan
tools.description: Validate a GeneratorPlan JSON for schema correctness without executing the pipeline. Returns valid=true/false and a list of errors.

tools.name: touring_generator_verify_plan
tools.description: Run VGP symbol verification only on a GeneratorPlan. Checks that all must_exist symbols are present in the touring index.

tools.name: touring_generator_render_plan
tools.description: Run VGP verify + template render on a GeneratorPlan. Stops before speculate and commit. Returns ok=true if rendering succeeds.

tools.name: touring_generator_speculate_plan
tools.description: Run VGP verify + render + speculate on a GeneratorPlan. Stops before commit. Use to validate the generated artifact without writing to disk.

tools.name: touring_generator_commit_plan
tools.description: Alias for touring_generator_submit_plan with dry_run=false. Runs the full pipeline and commits the artifact to disk.

tools.name: touring_generator_rollback_plan
tools.description: Check rollback availability for a plan's target file. Reports whether a .bak backup exists. Does not execute the restore — reports what would happen.

tools.name: touring_generator_schema_dump
tools.description: Emit the JSON Schema for the GeneratorPlan struct. Use to validate plan files programmatically or generate editor integrations.

tools.name: touring_generator_schema_check
tools.description: Check whether a GeneratorPlan version is compatible with the current engine. Returns compatibility status and available migration paths.

tools.name: touring_generator_bundle
tools.description: Execute multiple GeneratorPlans sequentially as a bundle. Pass plans_json as a Vec of plan JSON strings. Set dry_run=true to skip commits. Returns a manifest with per-plan stage results and aggregate counts.

tools.name: touring_generator_recall_similar
tools.description: Search touring memory for past generation patterns matching the query. Returns top-N matching memory entries ordered by relevance.

tools.name: touring_generator_plan_history
tools.description: Show the execution_trace lineage of a GeneratorPlan. Returns all trace entries populated by previous pipeline runs.

tools.name: touring_generator_critique_plan
tools.description: Analyze a GeneratorPlan structure and report issues: empty intent, missing contracts, invalid target paths. Returns error_count, warning_count, and issue list.

tools.name: touring_generator_suggest_plan
tools.description: Generate a skeleton GeneratorPlan JSON for the given intent and optional kind. Returns a ready-to-edit plan with sensible defaults. Replace plan_id and target.file_path before submitting.

tools.name: touring_generator_template_list
tools.description: List all 30 built-in Tera templates with their GeneratorKind, label, and template filename. Use template names with touring_generator_template_test.

tools.name: touring_generator_template_validate
tools.description: Validate a Tera template file for syntax errors. Pass the absolute path to a .tera file. Returns valid=true/false and any syntax errors.

tools.name: touring_generator_template_test
tools.description: Render a built-in template by name with given vars. Use touring_generator_template_list to get valid template names. Pass vars as a JSON object string.

tools.name: touring_generator_kinds_list
tools.description: List all 30 GeneratorKind variants with their label and template name. Alias for touring_generator_template_list with kind-focused output.

tools.name: touring_generator_capacity
tools.description: Show CapacityLimits defaults: max plan size, max contracts, token budget per CILA level. Use to understand pipeline constraints before submitting large plans.

tools.name: touring_generator_consumer_wiring
tools.description: Query orphan pub symbols from the wiring system and generate ConsumerGenerator plans for each wiring opportunity. Returns ok=true, count, and plans[]. Submit each plan via touring_generator_submit_plan to create wiring implementations.

tools.name: touring_generator_schema_registry_info
tools.description: Query the SchemaRegistry: engine version, number of migration paths, and migration keys. Use before schema_check to understand what versions are available.

tools.name: touring_generator_registry_status
tools.description: List all in-flight generator plans from the PlanRegistry. Returns plan_id, intent_preview, and execution status for each registered plan. Use filter to restrict to a specific plan_id prefix.

tools.name: touring_streaming_mcts
tools.description: Streaming Monte Carlo Tree Search for multi-step planning decisions. Takes a search_state string and runs progressive MCTS search with intermediate results available via tokio watch channel. Unlike touring_mcts_search which blocks until complete, this tool returns immediately with the best result found so far. Use for background planning without blocking the UI. Typical use: pass a state string, get best_action with confidence score.

tools.name: touring_online_learn
tools.description: Snapshot of the online RL engine: recent_reward EMA, update_count, per-tool bandit stats, convergence_status. Verify RL is receiving reward signals and identify underperforming tools.

tools.name: touring_wiring_audit
tools.description: Deep wiring audit using H83 IntegrationCompletenessHandler. Returns orphan_count, per-module integration scores, and recommendations. Optional module_filter restricts audit to a specific module path.

tools.name: touring_wiring_suggest
tools.description: Query pending wiring suggestions for orphan pub symbols from FileKnowledgeDB analysis. Pass orphanSymbol to filter to one symbol or omit to get all pending suggestions.

tools.name: touring_wasm_plugin
tools.description: Executes a WebAssembly plugin with fuel metering and sandbox isolation. The plugin must be a valid .wasm or .wat file. Feature: wasm-plugins.

tools.name: touring_blast_radius_analysis
tools.description: Focused blast radius analysis for a specific file. Returns name, score, issues from the blast_radius dimension. Faster than touring_analysis_report for single-file blast radius queries.

tools.name: touring_list_jobs
tools.description:
L7-B: List all jobs in the registry with their current status. \
                       Returns an array of {job_id, status, started_at_secs, is_terminal}.

tools.name: touring_drop_job
tools.description:
L7-B: Drop a job from the registry by id. If the job is still \
                       running, its JoinHandle is aborted. Returns {dropped: bool} — true \
                       if the job was found and removed, false if the id was unknown. \
                       Use after polling a terminal state to explicitly reclaim memory, \
                       or to cancel a long-running worker.

tools.name: touring_health_delta_reset
tools.description:
Wave 16: Reset per-path streak counters and discard any pending pre-record \
                       entry for the given file. Useful after a deliberate refactor checkpoint \
                       where the operator wants to start tracking from a known-good baseline. \
                       Returns {reset: true, file_path: <path>}.

tools.name: touring_ast_todos
tools.description:
List TODO/FIXME annotations stored in the knowledge index. \
                       Pass an absolute file_path to filter to one file, or leave empty \
                       to return all todos across the project.

tools.name: touring_ast_features
tools.description:
List feature flags per file from the knowledge index. \
                       Pass an absolute file_path to filter to one file, or leave empty \
                       to return all feature flags across the project.

tools.name: touring_ast_meta
tools.description:
Consolidated file metadata at skeleton/summary/full depth. \
                       skeleton: file_path, language, line_count, pub symbol names. \
                       summary: skeleton + cognitive_score, fan_in, fan_out, integration_score. \
                       full: summary + imports, todos, feature_flags.

tools.name: touring_search_symbols
tools.description:
Search for symbols by name using LIKE pattern matching against wiring_map. \
                       Returns ranked results with file paths and symbol kinds. \
                       Use % as wildcard, e.g. '%Handler' matches all handler symbols.

tools.name: touring_search_docs
tools.description:
Full-text search in file documentation and knowledge context. \
                       Searches file_knowledge.notes and symbols_json for the query string. \
                       Returns file paths, language, and matching context snippets.

tools.name: touring_query_dsl
tools.description:
Query file metadata with a simple DSL. \
                       Syntax: 'field op value [AND field op value ...]'. \
                       Supported fields: lang, language, loc, line_count, symbol_count, read_count. \
                       Supported operators: =, !=, >, <, >=, <=, LIKE. \
                       Example: 'lang = rust AND loc > 100'. Returns up to 50 matching files.

tools.name: touring_session_summary
tools.description:
Get session file summaries for a specific file path. \
                       Returns skeleton JSON, purpose, top gotchas, and blast severity \
                       from previous sessions that touched this file.

tools.name: touring_wiring_purpose
tools.description:
Get the purpose of a module — its role, exports, imports, \
                       and integration score from the dependency graph. \
                       Returns module_role, integration_score, pub symbol count, \
                       import list, and notes from the knowledge index.

tools.name: touring_assist_list_kinds
tools.description:
List all available refactor assist kinds. Returns each assist's \
                       id and group. Use this before `touring_assist_applicable` to \
                       discover what assists are available in this codebase.

tools.name: touring_tantivy_search
tools.description:
BM25 full-text search over the symbol index. \
                       Returns ranked hits with symbol_name, file_path, kind, score. \
                       Faster than SQL FTS5 for large corpora.

tools.name: touring_tantivy_fuzzy
tools.description:
Fuzzy search over symbols with Levenshtein edit-distance tolerance. \
                       Use when exact BM25 search misses due to typos or partial names.

tools.name: touring_tantivy_stats
tools.description:
Snapshot of Tantivy FTS index health: total_docs, index_size_bytes, \
                       pending_ops, total_commits, total_upserts.

tools.name: touring_tantivy_suggest
tools.description:
Autocomplete prefix suggestions from the symbol index. \
                       Returns symbol names whose lowercased form starts with `prefix`.

tools.name: touring_tantivy_reindex
tools.description:
Clear and reset the Tantivy FTS index. Removes all documents and commits. \
                       The daemon repopulates incrementally via hooks. \
                       Use after schema migration or index corruption.
